Pixel art character sprite of a Mega-level holy knight warrior inspired by Dukemon / Gallantmon, heroic upright combat stance, three-quarter front view.

Visual Design:
- Armor & Colors: Full-body polished silver and white chrome plate armor with gold filigree trims, large curved crimson-red shoulder pauldrons with gold spikes, and a flowing crimson-red cape behind the back.
- Helmet & Head: Silver knight helm with a crimson-red dragon-crested visor, glowing cyan eyes behind the slit, and an extra-long flowing silver ribbon plume extending dynamically from the top of the helmet.
- Torso & Limbs: Slender yet powerful robotic/cybernetic silhouette, black hazardous triangle crest on the silver chestplate, segmented red waist belts, pointed gold and crimson knee armor with black hazard markings, and armored silver sabatons with gold-plated pointed toes.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 resolution canvas.
- High-contrast metallic reflections, clean bold outlines, vibrant crimson and gold accents.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
